metaTitle: Custom Polypropylene Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom polypropylene lanyards & badges in bulk. Durable, lightweight, and perfect for events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Polypropylene lanyards offer a cost-effective yet durable solution for events, trade shows, and daily employee ID badges. Unlike nylon or polyester, polypropylene is lightweight and resists fraying, making it ideal for high-volume orders where budget matters. Choose from a wide range of colors and attachment options, including badge reels and safety breakaways. Perfect for marketing directors and HR managers needing reliable, custom-branded lanyards that hold up through daily use.
heroAltText: Custom polypropylene lanyards and badges with full-color imprint, available in bulk for events and corporate ID.
